_note: The daily practice plan is built from these pools (js/plan.js): each slot takes `n` items, rotating by date so the plan changes every day. Ids are stable — check-offs are stored against them. `pose` is a move id from moves.json or an exercise id from exercises.json. `tags` = which corrections the item helps with.

pool.text: Warm-up 5 min: jumping jacks, arm circles, leg swings
Warm-up 5 min: march, skips, jumping jacks, big arm circles
Warm-up 5 min: jog in place, leg swings front and side, roll the shoulders
Hollow hold + superman, 3×20s
Plank + side plank, 2×20–30s
Boat pose 3×15s — toes pointed, chest tall
Slow sit-ups 2×12, arms by the ears
Superman holds 3×15s — long arms, long legs
Side plank 2×20s each side, top arm long
Hollow rocks 2×15 — keep the low back down
Pike sit + reach 3×20s, pointed feet
Slow relevés 2×15 + single-leg balance 20s each
Lying leg lifts, straight knee, 2×10 per side
Glute bridges 2×12, squeeze at the top
Squats 2×12 — knees over toes, chest up
Lunges 2×8 each leg, back knee low, arms up
Single-leg squats 2×6 each leg (hold the counter)
Wall sit 2×30s
Jump lunges 2×10, soft landings
Calf raises 2×20, slow down, pointed foot at the top
Right, left, middle split + straddle, 20–30s each (after warm-up only)
Straddle: reach centre, right, left, 20s each (after warm-up only)
Cobra then seal, 3×10s — warm the back before any bridge
Pike stretch 3×20s, knees straight, feet pointed then flexed
Passé balance on relevé 5–10s, both sides
10 single pirouettes each side
Kicks/développés to hip height, straight knee, pointed foot
Arms overhead in the mirror: long elbows, shoulders down
Spotting drill: quarter turns, eyes on one sticker, 2×8
Walk the opening with eyes up to the top back row, 4 times
Arabesque hold 2×10s each side, hips square, knee straight
Point and flex 2×20, slow — feel the toes reach
Pliés in first and second with the music, 2×8, arms with the beat
8 counts of sharp hits and freezes with the jazz track

runs.text: Solo: mark once, then FULL OUT once with eyes up
